verdict.rationale: Paddle's merchant-of-record model is documented to automatically calculate, collect, register, file, and remit sales tax/VAT/GST across 200+ countries with 'no extra engineering effort' (paddle-supp-mor-tax, paddle-docs-21), and payout reports break out tax rates/tax mode for compliance proof (paddle-supp-payout-reconciliation); pricing pages also show estimated taxes (paddle-docs-2). However, community evidence shows a concrete real-world failure — a customer reporting Paddle used the wrong VAT number (pre/post-Brexit confusion) and wrong currency on a VAT invoice (paddle-comm-1) — while another user praises Paddle's VAT handling as superior to competitors (paddle-comm-2), creating a genuine dispute between vendor claims and hands-on experience. Missing for 10: independent audit/benchmark of tax accuracy across jurisdictions, resolution details on the VAT invoice complaint, and broader third-party verification beyond a single anecdote.
